short_metadata.title: Why Big Tech is Overrated
short_metadata.description:
Alright, gather 'round, 'synergy' enthusiasts! Your favorite Tech Megacorp just "realigned" 10,000 human jobs, all to strategically invest in the future. That future? A state-of-the-art AI chatbot whose groundbreaking innovation is recommending clam chowder recipes when you ask about market trends. Because why have a workforce when you can have an expensive, hallucinating digital chef? Subscribe for more corporate burns.

headline: A multi-billion dollar EV company recalling all cars because the touch screen won't let you roll down the windows

long_metadata.title: The Full Corporate Tech Reality Check
long_metadata.description:
Your multi-billion dollar EV, designed by literal rocket scientists, just got recalled. Turns out, that sleek, all-encompassing touchscreen won't let you roll down the windows. Apparently, basic human needs like fresh air are just *too* analog for the future of driving. Subscribe for more corporate burns.
